name: The Dragon's Beacon
summary: Argynvost lit a beacon at the top of his tower every night so the valley would know someone was keeping watch. It has been dark since he died.

stages.journal: Argynvostholt's tower once held a beacon the dragon lit every night. Sir Godfrey says it went out when he died, and that the commander won't hear it spoken of. Something in the chapel still answers questions, some nights.
stages.hint: Visit the chapel on Argynvostholt's ground floor.

stages.journal: The echo of the dragon Argynvost lingers in his chapel. His skull hangs in Strahd's castle as a trophy; brought home to his bones, it would keep the beacon burning for good once it's lit. But a little of his fire still sleeps in the bones themselves: enough to light it for one night, and one night would be enough to let his knights go.
objectives: Kindle the dragon's fire at his bones in the mausoleum
Carry it to the beacon at the top of the tower
stages.hint: Kindle the dragon's fire at his bones in the mausoleum on Argynvostholt's grounds, then carry it to the beacon at the top of the tower.

stages.journal: We carry a flame taken from the frost on the dragon's bones. It burns silver, gives no heat and casts no shadow. The commander will feel it moving through his house.
objectives: Light the beacon at the top of the tower
stages.hint: Carry the silver flame up to the beacon at the top of Argynvostholt's tower.

stages.journal: The beacon of Argynvostholt burns again. Its light reaches the castle on its rock, and every window in the valley.

The beacon stays dark for now. The dragon's fire still sleeps in the frost on his bones, in the mausoleum on Argynvostholt's grounds; kindled and carried up the tower, it would light the beacon again.
objectives: Kindle the dragon's fire at his bones in the mausoleum
Carry it to the beacon at the top of the tower
stages.hint: Kindle the dragon's fire at his bones in the mausoleum on Argynvostholt's grounds, then carry it to the beacon at the top of the tower.

stages.journal: We kept the oath sworn at Vladimir's table and lowered the silver flame before it touched the cradle. It went out in our hands, and with it the last of Argynvost. The beacon stays dark, and the Order still keeps its watch.
